title: Rate Limiting Middleware
goal: Implement granular rate limiting for different API endpoints to prevent abuse, brute-force attacks, and ensure fair resource usage.

sub_tasks.title: Create authLimiter (5 requests/15min)
sub_tasks.output: Strict rate limiter for auth endpoints to prevent brute force login attempts

sub_tasks.title: Create publicLimiter (50 requests/15min)
sub_tasks.output: Moderate rate limiter for public API endpoints

sub_tasks.title: Create webhookLimiter (200 requests/15min)
sub_tasks.output: High-capacity rate limiter for WhatsApp webhook traffic

sub_tasks.title: Create externalLimiter (100 requests/15min)
sub_tasks.output: Rate limiter for external integration endpoints (99acres, MagicBricks, Housing)

sub_tasks.title: Create agentLimiter (30 requests/15min)
sub_tasks.output: Rate limiter for partner agent portal endpoints

sub_tasks.title: Create apiLimiter (100 requests/15min)
sub_tasks.output: Rate limiter for internal authenticated staff API

acceptance_criteria: Six different rate limiters created with appropriate limits
Standard rate limit headers included (RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, etc.)
Meaningful error messages for rate limit violations
Legacy headers disabled for modern API design
result_summary: Comprehensive rate limiting system implemented with six specialized limiters. Each endpoint category has appropriate limits: auth (5/15min for brute-force protection), public (50/15min), webhooks (200/15min for high WhatsApp traffic), external integrations (100/15min), partner agents (30/15min), and internal API (100/15min). All use standard headers and return clear error messages.
